## Geospatial and remote sensing analyst — federal variant (P1)

*Function:* Turn spatial and remotely sensed data into validated map and model products whose accuracy and limits are stated for the decision they serve.

*X4 match:* `skos:relatedMatch` (confidence 0.4, applies to: geography assignments; candidate agent draft, evidence J). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

*Credential gates (draft, not shown as fact until sourced):* GIS Professional (GISP) (preferred)

### Developmental and full performance — indicative band GS-9 to GS-11 (journey) (not a classification criterion)

**Major duties (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- **Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions** — 40%
  - Interpret satellite and aerial imagery to detect changes in vegetation, soil or water condition across a management area between two dates. *(critical, needed at entry)*
  - Classify preprocessed multispectral imagery into land-cover types using training data whose collection method and date are documented. *(critical, needed at entry, formation task)*
  - Preprocess imagery for analysis by correcting geometry, radiometry and cloud or shadow contamination, documenting each step and its parameters. *(needed at entry)*
  - Assess the accuracy of a remotely sensed map against independent field reference data, reporting error by class and condition. *(critical, needed at entry)*
- **Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data** — 26%
  - Run spatial queries and overlays for an environmental assessment, checking that all layers share a coordinate reference system and compatible scales. *(needed at entry)*
  - Analyze terrain, habitat connectivity or resource distribution for a planning question, stating the data, projection and accuracy limits that bound the answer. *(needed at entry)*
  - Build a predictive spatial model for a conservation planning question, documenting its inputs, assumptions and validation against independent locations.
  - Maintain spatial layers of land use, vegetation and infrastructure with topology rules, attribute standards and update dates recorded. *(needed at entry)*
- **Design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty** — 14%
  - Design a map for a stated audience and decision, choosing scale, extent, symbology and colour that the audience reads correctly. *(needed at entry)*
  - Depict the uncertainty of a mapped or charted estimate with an encoding that intended users read correctly in a comprehension check.
  - Produce maps for reports, briefings and field crews at the scale, extent and legibility each use requires. *(needed at entry)*
- **Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code** — 7%
  - Write a script that automates a repetitive data-processing step, with tests that confirm it reproduces the manual result on sample data. *(needed at entry, formation task)*
  - Record the software environment, package versions and inputs of an analysis so that it can be re-run years later. *(needed at entry)*
  - Review AI-generated analysis code line by line against the analysis plan, testing it on cases with known answers before use. *(critical)*
- **Build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations** — 4%
  - Validate a detection model against field ground-truth data, reporting error by habitat, season and image condition. *(critical)*
- **Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions** — 2%
  - Report results with the uncertainty the method provides, such as intervals or confidence classes, keeping it in every summary of the result.
- **Steward and publish environmental data for reuse** — 2%
  - Document a dataset's sources, methods, formats and fitness for use in a metadata record that meets the applicable standard. *(needed at entry)*
- **Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products** — 2%
  - Generalize sensitive fields in the distributed copy of a dataset, or withhold them, while leaving the stored record unaltered and explaining each withheld field. *(critical)*
- **Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems** — 2%
  - Verify the positional accuracy of uncrewed-aircraft survey products against independently surveyed check points before release to users
- **Validate AI-generated work products before professional use** — 2%
  - Validate a large batch of AI detections or comment codes by drawing a defined sample, reviewing it and estimating the batch error rate. *(formation task)*

**Factor 1 — knowledge required (draft language)**

- Knowledge of and skill in: analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions (EMST target journey L2). *Distinguishing.*
- Knowledge of and skill in: conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence (EMST target journey L2). *Distinguishing.*
- Knowledge of and skill in: quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: validate AI-generated work products before professional use (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field (EMST target journey L1).
- Knowledge of and skill in: design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty (EMST target journey L2).
- Knowledge of and skill in: build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations (EMST target journey L2).

### Senior and lead — indicative band GS-12 to GS-13 (senior); GS-13 to GS-14 (lead) (not a classification criterion)

**Major duties (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- **Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions** — 40%
  - Interpret satellite and aerial imagery to detect changes in vegetation, soil or water condition across a management area between two dates. *(critical, needed at entry)*
  - Classify preprocessed multispectral imagery into land-cover types using training data whose collection method and date are documented. *(critical, needed at entry, formation task)*
  - Preprocess imagery for analysis by correcting geometry, radiometry and cloud or shadow contamination, documenting each step and its parameters. *(needed at entry)*
  - Assess the accuracy of a remotely sensed map against independent field reference data, reporting error by class and condition. *(critical, needed at entry)*
- **Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data** — 24%
  - Run spatial queries and overlays for an environmental assessment, checking that all layers share a coordinate reference system and compatible scales. *(needed at entry)*
  - Analyze terrain, habitat connectivity or resource distribution for a planning question, stating the data, projection and accuracy limits that bound the answer. *(needed at entry)*
  - Build a predictive spatial model for a conservation planning question, documenting its inputs, assumptions and validation against independent locations.
  - Evaluate alternative management scenarios with overlay and suitability analysis, documenting weights and criteria so that reviewers can test them.
- **Design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty** — 11%
  - Design a map for a stated audience and decision, choosing scale, extent, symbology and colour that the audience reads correctly. *(needed at entry)*
  - Depict the uncertainty of a mapped or charted estimate with an encoding that intended users read correctly in a comprehension check.
  - Produce maps for reports, briefings and field crews at the scale, extent and legibility each use requires. *(needed at entry)*
- **Build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations** — 8%
  - Train a classification model to detect an invasive species in aerial imagery, documenting training data sources, dates and label quality.
  - Diagnose why a detection model fails at a new site or season, choosing between retraining and a documented restriction on its use.
  - Validate a detection model against field ground-truth data, reporting error by habitat, season and image condition. *(critical)*
- **Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence** — 4%
  - Validate a model against independent evidence with spatially or temporally blocked hold-outs or field reference data, reporting error by condition. *(critical)*
  - Check whether a planned use of a model output falls inside the model's intended purpose, data period and area before relying on it.
- **Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code** — 3%
  - Record the software environment, package versions and inputs of an analysis so that it can be re-run years later. *(needed at entry)*
  - Review AI-generated analysis code line by line against the analysis plan, testing it on cases with known answers before use. *(critical)*
- **Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions** — 2%
  - Report results with the uncertainty the method provides, such as intervals or confidence classes, keeping it in every summary of the result.
- **Steward and publish environmental data for reuse** — 2%
  - Document a dataset's sources, methods, formats and fitness for use in a metadata record that meets the applicable standard. *(needed at entry)*
- **Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products** — 2%
  - Generalize sensitive fields in the distributed copy of a dataset, or withhold them, while leaving the stored record unaltered and explaining each withheld field. *(critical)*
- **Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field** — 2%
  - Design a field validation sample with an analyst, setting strata, sample size and access limits for a remote-sensed or AI product
- **Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems** — 2%
  - Verify the positional accuracy of uncrewed-aircraft survey products against independently surveyed check points before release to users
- **Design decision-support products for actual decision contexts** — 2%
  - Map the decision a product must support, including who decides, when, under what authority and with which constraints, before design starts.

**Factor 1 — knowledge required (draft language)**

- Knowledge of and skill in: analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions (EMST target senior L3, lead L4). *Distinguishing.*
- Knowledge of and skill in: conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data (EMST target senior L3, lead L4).
- Knowledge of and skill in: protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products (EMST target senior L2, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code (EMST target senior L3, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence (EMST target senior L3, lead L4). *Distinguishing.*
- Knowledge of and skill in: quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions (EMST target senior L3, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: validate AI-generated work products before professional use (EMST target senior L3, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field (EMST target senior L2, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty (EMST target senior L3, lead L3).
- Knowledge of and skill in: build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations (EMST target senior L3, lead L4).
